messages:
liz: Quick UX review from usability session: users expected a "rewind" affordance when they stopped a stream. They tapped Stop then wanted to go back a few tokens to edit. omar: Interesting. Do we want full rewind (rewind N tokens) or just regenerate from prompt w/ edit? Rewind adds complexity to backend state. kevin: Prefer add-on: "Stop" should snapshot the current buffer and show two actions: Regenerate (from start) and Rewind (step back 20 tokens). Rewind can be client-side if we keep a local token buffer. liz: Accessibility note: when Stop is pressed the focus should move into the small overlay with the two actions. Screen readers need an announcement: "Generation stopped. 472 tokens generated." sasha: For SR we should expose a short live message:
Generation stopped, 472 tokens
. Also make the Rewind control reachable via keyboard with shortcut R when overlay is open. kevin: Token budget / meter: users in the study asked for an inline budget hint (e.g., "budget: 3.2k tokens left") not just absolute token count. Proposal: collapse the large token counter into a compact pill and show full numbers on hover. Important: aria-hidden the decorative pill and put the budget text in sr-only region updated as generation proceeds. liz: Copy suggestion: visible pill text "Tokens 472" -> badge. sr-only text: "Streaming, 472 tokens. Budget remaining: 2,528 tokens." omar: Visual layout debate: where to put the compact pill? Left of controls felt less cluttered in prototype B. But we must keep logical DOM order: controls first, content second, counters later for a11y. kevin: Implementation sketch for DOM order + SR region: ```
...streaming tokens...
Tokens 472
Streaming 12 tokens. Budget remaining: 2,528 tokens.
``` sasha: Minor: use assertive for the initial "Streaming started" and polite for ongoing counts; otherwise screen readers might ignore the start event. Also confirm the stop overlay gets role=dialog and focus trap. liz: Prompt library tweak: allow pinning prompts to top and keyboard nav with arrow keys + Enter to insert. Add aria-labels like "Prompt: , pinned" when pinned. Users liked being able to pin common prompts. omar: We'll prototype client-side rewind + token buffer and a11y changes. I'll add a feature flag so we can test with customers. kevin: I'll open PR playground/stream-rewind-tokenpill and add unit tests for DOM order + a11y announcements. tagging @sasha for review. :sparkles: sasha: Looks good. tiny styling nit: pill should have 12px vertical padding and 10px horizontal per spec. liz: Thanks all. attaching session notes and screencap. landing copy + keyboard shortcuts in same PR will make QA easier. :thumbsup:
